description: Variation of condition 7 (energy strategy) to allow the re-wording of the condition of planning permission 00994/D/P1 (P/2021/3938) approved 08/04/2022 for the erection of five two storey houses with associated cycle and waste storage, landscaping and boundary treatment following demolition of existing garages.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - In accordance with approved drawings

The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (3667K-LB-XX-ZZ-DRA-101000 P2, 3667-LB-XX-DR-A-110000 P2, 3667K-LB-XX-ZZ-DR-A-101001 P2, 3667K-LBXX-ZZ-DR-A-300000 P2, 3667K-LB-XX-02-DR-A-120002 P2, Design and Access Statement, Drainage and Flood Risk Checklist, Drainage Assessment Form, Daylight & Sunlight Report, Cover Letter, Planning Statement, Preliminary Groundwater Screening Assessment, Sustainability Report Rev A and Transport Note. Received on 1 October 2021; Construction Logistics Plan. Received on 13 January 2022; 3667K-LB-XX-ZZ-DR-A-130000 T2, 3667K-LB-ZZ-SH-A-600003 T1 and Revised Document Tracker. Received on 19 January 2022; Internal Daylight & Sunlight Analysis. Received on 1 February 2022; Design Fire Strategy. Received on 22 February 2022; Flood Risk Assessment. Received on 25 February 2022; 3667K-LB-XX-00-DR-A-120000 P2, 3667K-LB-XX-01-DR-A-120001 P3, 3667K-LB-XX-ZZ-DR-A-140000 P3 and 3667K-LB-XX-00-DR-L-200000 T2. Received on 25 March 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 2 - Materials

The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the materials approved under P/2023/0481.

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 3 - Hard and soft landscaping

The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the hard and soft landscaping details approved under P/2023/2521.
The landscaping works shall thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the area and to promote biodiversity.
Condition : 4 - Boundary treatment

The development hereby permitted hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the boundary treatment details approved under P/2023/3399.
The works shall thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.

Reason: To safeguard the visual amenities of the locality and privacy of adjoining properties.
Condition : 5 - Restriction of permitted development

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the hereby approved development or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out. 

Reason: In order not to prejudice amenities of any adjoining properties and in order that the Local Planning Authority is able to exercise control over future development of the site.
Condition : 6 - Energy strategy

The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy and prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy and any subsequent approved revisions.

Reason: To ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions.
Condition : 7 - Internal water consumption

Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, the development shall have been constructed to achieve an internal water use of 105 litres/person/day or less as approved under P/2024/0854. 

Reason: In order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources.
Condition : 8 - Obscure glazing

All windows serving bathrooms of the hereby approved development as shown on drawing numbers 3667K-LB-XX-00-DR-A-120000 P2 and 3667K-LB-XX-01-DR-A-120001 P3 shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Reason: To safeguard the visual amenities of the locality and privacy of future occupiers.
Condition : 9 - Sustainable sourcing of materials

The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the sustainable materials details approved under P/2023/3399 requiring:

At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of 
A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.

At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.

No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Reason: In order to ensure the sustainable sourcing of materials.
Condition : 10 - Construction logistics plan

The development shall take place in accordance with the details contained within the approved Constructions Logistics Plan under P/2022/3140.

Reason: In order to ensure highway safety is maintained and preserved and to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties.
Condition : 11 - Hours of demolition and construction

No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: In order to protect the living conditions of neighbouring residents.
Condition : 12 - Mechanical services noise control

a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which this permission refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the plant operate. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or one metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142. An alternative position for assessment/measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria are achieved.

b) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter. 

c) Following installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted for approval to the local planning authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions. All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments. The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the local authority within 28 days of completion of the installation for review. If the plant fails to meet the specified standard, remedial measures shall be put in place immediately and the noise assessment shall be carried out again. Condition : 13 - Lighting

The development shall be implemented in accordance with the materials approved under P/2024/0688.

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 14 - Vehicular access - reinstate footway

The development shall be implemented in accordance with the kerb and footway reinstatement details approved under P/2023/0634.

Reason: To enhance the pedestrian environment and to confine vehicular access to the permitted points in order to ensure that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or highway safety along the adjacent highway.
Condition : 15 - Permit parking restrictions

The development shall take place in accordance with the permit parking restriction arrangements confirming the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings, to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit.

Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.

Reason: To ensure that the development does not result in congestion to the car park or an increase in off street parking in the area.
Condition : 16 - Delivery and servicing plan

The development shall take place in accordance with the details contained within the approved Delivery and Servicing Plan under P/2024/0562.

Reason: To ensure that deliveries are undertaken in an acceptable manner and in order to ensure that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or highway safety along the adjacent highway.
Condition : 17 - Cycle storage

The development shall be implemented in accordance with the cycle storage details approved under P/2023/0634.

Reason: To support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 18 - Waste management strategy

The development shall be implemented in accordance with the waste management strategy approved under P/2023/2521.

Reason: In the interests of the amenity of the area and to ensure the arrangements for waste collection are suitable.
Condition : 19 - Contamination

The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under P/2022/3011. 

During the course of the development:

A.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues. 
Before the development is first brought into use:

B.	Any necessary scheme for decontamination required by clause A) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Reason: Contamination is known or suspected on the site due to a former land use. It is therefore necessary to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety.

Supporting Notes:

(i)	The full Phase II site investigation, where required, must include sampling and/or testing for soil and groundwater contamination, soil gasses, vapours and leachate and test for potential contaminants identified within the Phase I Preliminary Risk Assessment. 

(ii)	The investigation shall be carried out at such points and at such depths as the local planning authority may stipulate. 

(iii)	Testing for Total Hydrocarbons shall be undertaken using the TPH-CWG method. Where significant contamination is identified, to fully characterise the site the extent of this contamination should be confirmed by further intrusive site investigation and testing (i.e. delineation works). 

(iv)	Risk assessments must adhere to current UK guidance and best practice. 

The Council requests that site investigation reports or site plans be sent electronically to landquality@hounslow.gov.uk or by post on a USB
Condition : 20 - Sustainable drainage scheme

The sustainable drainage scheme approved under P/2022/3366 and P/2024/2314 shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.

Reason: In order to prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site.
Condition : 21 - Tree and hedge retention

In this condition 'retained tree' means any existing trees and hedges which are to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of five years from the date of the occupation of any of the buildings hereby approved.

(a) No retained tree (or hedge) shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree (and hedge) be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority. Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work) or any other BS replacing this. Appropriate measures shall be taken in accordance with industry best practice to protect the retained trees for the duration of the works on site.

(b) If any retained tree (or hedge) is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To enable the Local Planning Authority to ensure the protection of retained trees from damage, in the interests of visual amenity.
Condition : 22 - Design Out Crime

The development shall achieve 'Secured by Design' accreditation awarded by the Design-Out Crime Officer from the Metropolitan Police Service on behalf of the Association of Chief Police Officers (ACPO).

No dwelling shall be occupied until accreditation has been achieved and evidence of such accreditation has been submitted to the local planning authority.

Reason: In pursuance of the Council's duty under section 17 of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998.
